laws.rule: Reserva Nacional Ñuble: The page still carries a winter public closure from 1 June 2026 with no confirmed reopening. The reserve spans Pinto in Ñuble and Antuco in Biobío; this entry concerns the named reserve, not all regional trails. The named unit prohibits fires and other heat sources, pets or exotic animals, leaving enabled trails and removing natural resources. Follow ranger instructions; no region-wide extension is made.

items.text: Reserva Nacional Ñuble: CONAF's own unit page prohibits consuming alcoholic drinks. This is the named protected-area condition, not an alcohol ban throughout the region.

Reserva Nacional Ñuble: smoking is prohibited in CONAF's published unit conditions. The same page prohibits consuming drugs or hallucinogenic products; no wider possession or prescribing rule is inferred.
